violation_type.title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Wash Napkins, Bibs and Tablecloths (26 TAC §746.3317(3))
violation_type.short_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Wash Napkins, Bibs and Tablecloths
violation_type.typical_finding: A caregiver was observed serving food to children on the bare table with no sanitary napkin.

finding_variants.text: A caregiver was observed serving food to children on the bare table with no sanitary napkin.
This standard was reviewed in relation to the investigation and found to be deficient. The caregiver was observed on camera placing children's snack directly on the table for the child to eat.
In the toddler classroom the teacher was observed serving cookies to the children on the bare table.    NOTE: This was corrected when napkins were being used.
